items.title: Eurreal Wilford "Little Brother" Montgomery Interview, 1958-05-29
items.q: Alvin Alcon, George, and Shine, the drummer they call Shine. Oh, yes. He was playing drums with us.

ctx.x: Yeah, there was French names, didn't there? Yeah.
And Oliver Alcon. Oh, yeah. Alvin Alcon. Well, George McCullin were first, and then Alvin taking his place.
